verdict.rationale: Fellow's own API docs say recordings include "diarized and timestamped transcripts," so speaker separation is a documented first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence shows speakers are matched to real names (for example via calendar attendees or participant identity) rather than generic labels, and there is no evidence on attribution accuracy. missing for 10: real-name speaker matching, evidence of attribution accuracy, user-facing documentation of speaker labeling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, the transcript attributes words to the right named speakers (diarization plus real name matching), not just "Speaker 1/2"

citations.quote: Each Recording is associated with a Note, and can contain information such as: Diarized and timestamped transcripts
